comments.author: Cypher27
comments.body_html:
I Love the thought of this mod! But, I couldn’t help but wonder why we can unpack ammo in raid but not these rations. Looking into the src of this mod I find that the rations are in a subfolder under assets/weapons/…

Would it be possible to rework it into being treated like the ammo packs in raid? I’m not a modder under any stretch of imagination. Just wanted to bring up the question.

comments.author: JustNU
comments.body_html:
ammo packages and “gift bags” that I based this mod on are two separate things, making gifts openable would require client patching, doable but not something i want to fuck with

They’re inside weapons folder because its technically a weapon, as this is the only way to make FPS animations for an item, every consumable in the game that have first person anims are in that folder (food, drinks, meds, stims, etc)

comments.author: Cypher27
comments.body_html: Ah okay, yeah I was just thinking maybe it was just a different way to do it. Thank you so much for the explanation as to why its under “weapons”. Didn’t know that. Appreciate the reply, and also your work!
